anchors.why: Pi, and OMP after it, title the pane `π - <session>` at rest (`π : <session>` while working). A pi build that rebrands its own title paints `Pi - <session>`, Orca's renderer rebrands it the same way, and OMP's owner label does the same for its panes, so all three brands are the same claim; the synthetic `<brand> - action required` permission label is the one hyphenated form that is not idle.

rules.why: Orca writes an explicit `Pi ready` title at rest, while a shell auto-title names Pi from launch, mid-turn too, so a bare name counts only once quiet (#6011).
